I2C OLED에 글자 표시: Showing text on an I2C OLED
SSD1306 OLED를 I2C 버스(D15 SCL, D14 SDA)에: Connect an SSD1306 OLED to the I2C bus (D15 SCL, D14 SDA) and show the RTC's time and the temperature and humidity on the screen.
I2C 두 선(SCL 클럭, SDA 데이터)과 7비트 주소로 여러 장치를: Connect several devices to one bus using the two I2C lines (SCL clock, SDA data) and 7-bit addresses
오픈 드레인과 풀업 저항이 필요한 이유를 안다: Understand why open drain and pull-up resistors are needed
버스 검색(scan) 결과로 연결을 확인한다: Confirm the connections with the result of a bus scan
**UART printf and a command parser** (communication basics).
RTC(DS3231)와 온습도 센서(AHT20)는 이미 I2C 버스에 연: The RTC (DS3231) and the temperature/humidity sensor (AHT20) are already on the I2C bus. Now attach the OLED to the same bus.
OLED의 `VCC`를 보드의 **3V3**에, `GND`를 **GND*: Connect the OLED's `VCC` to the board's **3V3** and `GND` to **GND**. You can also connect them to the RTC's pins of the same name.
I2C 신호: SCL → D15, SDA → D14: I2C signals: SCL → D15, SDA → D14
I2C는 두 선을 여러 장치가 함께 씁니다. 장치마다 **주소**가 달라: With I2C, several devices share two lines. Each device has a different **address** (OLED `0x3C`, RTC `0x68`, AHT20 `0x38`) that tells them apart.
두 선을 바꿔 꽂으면 OLED가 응답하지 않아 펌웨어가 `Error_Ha: If you swap the two lines, the OLED does not respond and the firmware stops in `Error_Handler()`.
**I2C 주소**: 장치마다 7비트 주소가 있습니다 — OLED 0x3: **I2C address**: every device has a 7-bit address — OLED 0x3C, DS3231 0x68, AHT20 0x38. The master (STM32) sends the address first,
그 주소의 장치만 ACK로 답합니다. HAL 함수에는 주소를 한 비트 왼: and only the device with that address answers with an ACK. HAL functions take the address shifted left by one bit (`0x3C << 1`).
SCL·SDA는 **오픈 드레인**: 누구나 0으로 당길 수만 있고, 1: SCL·SDA are **open drain**: anyone can only pull a line to 0, and the **pull-up resistor** makes the 1. That is why several devices can share one line without conflict.
SCL과 SDA를 바꿔 꽂으면 버스 검색에 아무것도 나오지 않습니다. D: If SCL and SDA are swapped, the bus scan finds nothing. D15 = SCL, D14 = SDA.
**▶ 실행**하면 콘솔에 버스 검색 결과 `scan: 0x38 0x3C: Press **▶ Run**: the console shows the bus scan result `scan: 0x38 0x3C 0x68`, and the OLED draws the date, time, temperature and humidity every second.
**채점**은 2.5초 동안 실행하며 펌웨어가 멈추지 않는지, 버스 검색: **Grade** runs for 2.5 seconds and checks that the firmware does not stop, that the bus scan sees the OLED, and that something is drawn on the screen.
펌웨어가 멈췄습니다. OLED가 I2C에 응답하지 않으면 Error_Ha: The firmware stopped. If the OLED does not respond on I2C, Error_Handler() is called. Check the SDA·SCL and power wiring.
OLED에 글자가 그려짐: Text is drawn on the OLED
OLED 주소를 0x78로 씀 — 0x78은 0x3C를 한 비트 민 '8: Using 0x78 as the OLED address — 0x78 is the '8-bit address', 0x3C shifted by one bit.
OLED에 여러분의 이름을 크게(scale 2) 그리도록 `text()`: Change the `text()` call so the OLED draws your name in large letters (scale 2).
